newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana mulls jewellery operations spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Egana mulls jewellery operations spinoff.

text.p: Watch and jewellery products manufacturer and distributor Egana International (Holdings) Ltd said on Thursday it was considering a separate listing of its jewellery operations on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

"The directors of the company announce that they are formulating proposals involving a separate listing of the group's jewellery operation on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Ltd," the company said in a statement.

"Formal application relating to the listing proposal has not been submitted to the stock exchange and that whether or not the listing proposal will be consummated will depend on a number of factors and is subject to the approval of the stock exchange," it added.
Egana said it was undertaking corporate reorganisation of its jewellery operations but the timing and the terms of the listing were still under consideration.
Somerley Ltd has been appointed as financial adviser, it said.
